e.title: insurance-evt
e.summary: 极值理论（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：GPD/GEV 拟合、profile likelihood、灾难性索赔严重度尾部
e.summary_en: Extreme Value Theory (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): GPD/GEV fitting, profile likelihood, catastrophic claim severity tails
e.summary_hk: 極值理論（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：GPD/GEV 擬合、profile likelihood、災難性索賠嚴重度尾部
e.body: insurance-evt（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）把极值理论用于保险定价：GPD/GEV 拟合、profile likelihood 推断、灾难性索赔的严重度尾部建模。对 RIAA：EVT 是重尾风险的数学基础（[[rim540]] 及精算核心）——与 [[insurance-severity]]（严重度拼接建模）、[[insurance-quantile]]（EQRN 极端分位）配套，构成 burning-cost 尾部分支全景；灾难性尾部决定再保险定价（[[reinsurance]] 视角）；GPD 超阈值模型（POT）是行业标准做法。
e.body_en: insurance-evt (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) brings extreme value theory to insurance pricing: GPD/GEV fitting, profile likelihood inference, catastrophic claim severity tails. For RIAA: EVT is the mathematical foundation of heavy-tail risk (core [[rim540]] material) — with [[insurance-severity]] (spliced severity) and [[insurance-quantile]] (EQRN extreme quantiles) it completes the burning-cost tail branch; catastrophic tails drive reinsurance pricing ([[reinsurance]] view); GPD peaks-over-threshold is the industry-standard approach.
e.body_hk: insurance-evt（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）把極值理論用於保險定價：GPD/GEV 擬合、profile likelihood 推斷、災難性索賠的嚴重度尾部建模。對 RIAA：EVT 是重尾風險的數學基礎（[[rim540]] 及精算核心）——與 [[insurance-severity]]（嚴重度拼接建模）、[[insurance-quantile]]（EQRN 極端分位）配套，構成 burning-cost 尾部分支全景；災難性尾部決定再保險定價（[[reinsurance]] 視角）；GPD 超閾值模型（POT）是行業標準做法。
